title: Feature-fusion model prioritizes antibacterial Ugi products
summary: LSCNN ranked a combinatorial Ugi library after model development on focused activity data. The paper reports six active products among ten selected combinations against MRSA; purified H4–H6 had MIC and MBC of 12 μM. Different screening phases and cutoffs mean these figures are not a randomized general hit-rate comparison.

evidence.tested: Primary article reports 6/10 selected combinations active against MRSA and purified H4–H6 MIC/MBC results.
evidence.unknown: Prior chemical-structure overlap, full independent replication, and clinical efficacy are not established.
evidence.ai_role: Model ranks products from combinatorial Ugi space for synthesis and testing.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, date, model role and bounded reported result.
